title: Crisp Chestnut Morning (8 AM)
subtitle: 8 AM · Cool October air & golden light
blurb: Brisk autumn morning through rustling amber leaves — warm felt piano, acoustic fingerpicked pluck, and an easygoing swung groove.

title: Bookshop Alley (11 AM)
subtitle: 11 AM · Dusty wooden shelves & warm organ
blurb: Browsing secondhand books down a sunlit autumn alley — buttery Rhodes jazz voicings, vintage organ warmth, and dusty boom-bap.

title: Golden Ginkgo Walk (2:30 PM)
subtitle: 2:30 PM · Yellow leaves carpeting the avenue
blurb: Bright afternoon sunlight filtering through golden ginkgo trees — warm Bb-major Rhodes, crisp guitar pluck, and an upbeat autumn strut.

title: Maple & Lanterns (5:30 PM)
subtitle: 5:30 PM · Crimson maples & glowing chochin
blurb: The album's centerpiece at amber twilight — nostalgic D-minor Rhodes 9ths, expressive Kyoto alley felt piano, lantern chimes, and deep boom-bap.

title: Roasted Tea & Dusk (8:30 PM)
subtitle: 8:30 PM · Warm hojicha & evening shadows
blurb: Steaming roasted green tea after sundown — smoky A-minor Rhodes, warm vintage organ swells, intimate felt piano, and sleepy boom-bap.

title: Lanterns Along the River (11 PM)
subtitle: 11 PM · Drifting golden reflections on dark water
blurb: Late-night calm along a dark autumn river reflecting glowing paper lanterns — tender felt piano, shimmering music-box bells, and soft brushes.
